question.text: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) KYC data privacy for Cat III AIFs:

answer.text: Data must be protected, shared only with consent and in compliance with data protection laws

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 5.23, AIFs can share KYC data with customer consent and in compliance with data protection laws. The Trap: Freedom/public-data approaches violate privacy norms. Cross-Exam Context: Tested in Topic 4. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Get explicit consent for any KYC data sharing even across group entities.
